items.name: 2-Ply
descriptions: Mummies make great friends because their plumage is naturally soft and absorbant: you can cry on their shoulder for days.

items.name: Wheels
descriptions: Earings, hats, headbands, headphones, earmuffs, bandanas. We're thinking too small here. Cars. Accessory of the future.

items.name: Pearce
descriptions: Haunted by a gluten allergy that was diagnosed until recent.  Unbeknownst for years while living on garlic bread.

items.name: Verisimilitude
descriptions: There are over a dozen puppeteers hidden within Verisimilitude. It gets cramped sometimes.

items.name: Walter
descriptions: A collector of fine confections.

items.name: Gunther
descriptions: Lost at sea for years aboard a derelict freighter. After finding a viking cap inside of a shipping container, Gunther has since found a new purpose in life.

items.name: Manbirth
descriptions: Look this happens all the time. It just doesn't get that much coverage in the media, but more common than you would think. Like blue ice.

items.name: Spork
descriptions: Dual purposed duality.

items.name: Cranberry
descriptions: Younger brother of Franklin. Less successful than John-Paul.

items.name: Alien
descriptions: Where is my spaceship!?!?

items.name: Sniffy Sniffs
descriptions: An answer for kitten farts. Of course, the smell of plastic and rubber is far worse.

items.name: Cheeseborough
descriptions: What can I say? The man knows how to clamp!

items.name: Yarn Ball
descriptions: Yarn is by far much more rare than Gems.  It's the primary currency for bribing the Cat Guards for new weapons, but of course can be traded for anything.

items.name: Boot
descriptions: A wise old cobbler predicted the singularity would occur in technology. I'll give you a guess as to what field.

items.name: Marco
descriptions: The worst part about a face-ectomy is that people don't know where to look when they're talking to you, and it makes everyone uncomfortable. The mask helps.

items.name: Crikey
descriptions: Crikey and Arnold were found on a life raft in the middle of the ocean.  Close to starvation these two found a home aboard the SS Friendship.

items.name: Chester
descriptions: A shell of his former self.  Once a great explorer, now sits quietly in his living quarters drawing diagrams of litterboxes.

items.name: Susie Q. Anthony
descriptions: Solving mysteries may come naturally to some girls, but sometimes you also upstage the police and end up in prison run by cats.

items.name: Champion
descriptions: Just think of the bacon make-outs...

items.name: Rawls
descriptions: After a childhood food incedent involving rock candy, Rawls underwent a highly experimental jaw sugery that infused him with a metal mandible.

items.name: Sleepover Simon
descriptions: Be sure to look under your bed.

items.name: Plane Jane
descriptions: Turbines are for circle heads.

items.name: Sygourney
descriptions: Known for amazing hair, this one has starred in multiple BattleBlock Theater promotional advertisements.

items.name: Pepper
descriptions: Prisoner by day. Origamist by night. Professional hanglider in dreams.

items.name: Pascal
descriptions: Be very, very careful. For Pascal's attenae do absolutely nothing at all but make you look foolish!

items.name: Fleur de sol
descriptions: A little of this, a little of that.  A dash of prison, a smidge of theater.  Voila!

items.name: Yuzu
descriptions: Sweet and sour and full of zest.  Yuzu has untamable sass that does not mesh well with his fellow captives.

items.name: Conseco
descriptions: Mouth full of flys. Full of them.

items.name: grizzle
descriptions: One moment, I was at a slumber party.  The next... jail.

items.name: Safety First
descriptions: This is actually a medically prescribed helmet.  True story.

items.name: Easter Elle
descriptions: Always supportive of her big brother, even when he fails.

items.name: Sir Sneak-a-Peek
descriptions: Of noble birth, Sir Sneak is the last in a long line of donut critics.

items.name: Skids
descriptions: Dashing, dapper, debonnair. Skid knows not what these words mean.

items.name: Don'tLookAtMe
descriptions: Eyes so beautiful one cannot gaze for more than a second before being hypnotized by their beauty.

items.name: Aloe
descriptions: Sentient aloe leaf broken and dried, but filled with life and fervor.

items.name: The Babysitter
descriptions: Charges way too much an hour to sleep on your couch.

items.name: Nigel
descriptions: Custom monacles are surprisingly cheap.

items.name: WeeWee
descriptions: Some would say a scoundrel. Otheres, a rascal. WeeWee will have to learn what it takes to survive in BattleBlock Theater.

items.name: Greystone
descriptions: Traumatized by a car accident involving a truck filled with carrots.  Greystone has turned carrots into carrot... cake and owns a carrot cakery back home.  Some day after being freed he will return and take up his mantle as head patissiere.

items.name: Franklin
descriptions: Grows imitation beards and sells them on the black market. Led his younger brother Cranberry astray.

items.name: Serioustown
descriptions: This man is permanently less than indifferent.

items.name: Ivan
descriptions: Fabled lost cosmonaut has in actuality been misadventuring with this group of castaways.

items.name: Cristoff
descriptions: This one time Cristoff went on a family vacation and was introduced to oysters for the first time.  Changed his life. When he grew up he went to a restaurant and to his surprise what he thought were oysters were actually soy beans.

items.name: Skin Flap McZak
descriptions: He started peeling at the tender age 162.  Now his flaps just flap about, but he does not see it anymore.  They are a part of him much like a limb or and eyeball or hair folicle.

items.name: Kirby Lobewax
descriptions: Kirby looks forward to a bright future of easy-access ear hair removal.

items.name: Beats
descriptions: Playing good songs in good orders got this one a job aboard the S.S. Friendship. But I'll let you in on a little secret... they're not headphones.  They're actualy ear muffs. Shhhhhhhh.

items.name: Sly
descriptions: Sometimes being stealthy just means being mindful of your surroundings. And gaps of course.

items.name: Geordie Manflakes
descriptions: See those things on his head? Some kid stuck those on back in 3rd grade and he still hasn't noticed.

items.name: Rosencrantz
descriptions: Shakespeare is by far more difficult to communicate via antennae. Truly the next level in theater can neither be seen nor heard.  Unless! it's say a battle type of theater...

items.name: Ramekin Eyetalker
descriptions: It's rude to stare, even if you're from a galaxy far, far away.

items.name: Chef
descriptions: This goatee makes my food taste good.

items.name: Surpreyes
descriptions: There is such a thing as too much depth-perception.

items.name: Beetie
descriptions: An unparalleled affinity for the red nectar of the beet.  You see it's a noble vegetable, but virutally untradable with Cat Guards.

items.name: Sven
descriptions: Have you ever tasted sadness? I have. For he was my friend.

items.name: Purrtricia
descriptions: Several incidents with the guards and some yarn resulted in some electro-zapper block therapy.  This once feral creature now sits catatonic in a cell with the look of emptiness in her eyes.  Quite tragic really.

items.name: Cyber Manny
descriptions: Read the fine print when shopping on Cyber Monday. Sometimes its a discount laptop, and sometimes its a discount laptop with an agreement to donate your body to medical experiments. Long story short, Cyber Manny.

items.name: Nikola
descriptions: These glasses are needed for his experiments.  Oh, the experiments are in modern dance.

items.name: Reverse Merman
descriptions: Being a reverse merman has a TON of benefits, survival-wise: gills for below water, lungs for above. Webbed toes that walk as well as they swim. Of course, the species is doomed because no girl will ever kiss one.

items.name: Willie the Kid
descriptions: Turns out, being a train robber is a lot less complicated than being a boat robber.

items.name: Rigel
descriptions: Brother to Nigel. This fraternal twin hangs on the side of the triangles though suffers the same occular limitations as his brother.

items.name: Banana Man
descriptions: Ooh ooh ah ah?

items.name: Pretty Please
descriptions: #He'd always meant to get it checked out, but the staff at Yogurt Palace had been surpringly good with sudden head trauma.

items.name: Isosceles II
descriptions: Isosceles II's tomb was his first, and last, self-portrait.

items.name: Princess Tee hee
descriptions: Her Highness, the lady of giggle-snorts, heiress to Fannyfield Home.

items.name: Nostridomus
descriptions: Nostridomus can smell the future, and the future smells like prison and litterboxes.

items.name: Persius
descriptions: Abandoned by his father, Poseidon, after he accidentally spat in his mouth.

items.name: Farmer Phil
descriptions: Gonna eat your grains and brain your knowledge.

items.name: Up All Night
descriptions: She once found herself in a shopping mall made up entirely of coffee shops. After surviving on caramel, espresso and biscotti for 3 weeks, she finally escaped into the blinding sun. She has not slept since.

items.name: Secret Mission Guy 2
descriptions: Finding gems is way harder when everything looks green, but he wanted a challenge.

items.name: Sir Silvergrill
descriptions: After slaying Dribbles the Sea Dragon, Sir Silvergrill later opened an online dragon skin belt store.

items.name: Bird Boy
descriptions: Being cross-bred with a bird can have its advantages when you're on a prison island. Less so if the bird you were bred with was flightless.

items.name: Roscoe
descriptions: Surprisingly, once you grow your hair out long enough, you go from being hairy to furry. Fluffy even. Roscoe, you have arrived!

items.name: Earl
descriptions: Order in the court!  I have a wig!

items.name: Benedict
descriptions: Master detective. Brain like an encyclopedia. Utterly ruined by the invention of the internet.

items.name: Snow
descriptions: Winter is coming. We're on a tropical island though, so it should be pretty nice.

items.name: Walter
descriptions: Walter suffers from an overwhelming sense of self consciousness. Luckily being holed up a ship for months on end followed by prison, tends to tear down such social barriers.

items.name: Noir
descriptions: Back in eleventy-eleventeen they didn't call them juiceboxes.  Instead they were called, er,  juice glasses.

items.name: Pineapple Pete
descriptions: The failed mascot for Antarctic Pineaples.

items.name: Humphrey Rodriguez
descriptions: Notorious pinch-hitter. Seriously, watch out: first he pinches you, and then he hits you right on the nose.

items.name: Vinegar Cheeks
descriptions: Some people pickle cucumbers. Some onions and carrots. This guy pickled his head. This is what happens when you pickle your head.

items.name: Angry Andy
descriptions: Life lesson of the day: don't let yourself be defined by the shape of your eyebrows. Unless you're like Andy and that's the best thing going for you.

items.name: Shock Victim
descriptions: This one has a long history with objects with electrical properties. He may no his way around a zapper block, but the encounter may prove too traumatic.

items.name: Amphibalope
descriptions: Amphibalopes were once bred for size and storage capacity, and they were the leading walk-in animal of their day. The species took a big hit in popularity once someone invented a closet that smelled less terrible and was less likely to die.

items.name: Grotto
descriptions: This one time my friend Tots and I were at an 80s party.  We both wore hats because we were hat buddies. He was a bit confused about multi-themed rooms and worried about his glasses or something.  I was obviously busy having a sporting time in my new hat.  You see it'a hat.  Did I mention I love hats?

items.name: Girp
descriptions: After fulfilling the family mission to smite Poiseidon, he was left with a sense of emptiness after shipwrecking. Directionless he awaits a cause.  A cause that will reignite the fire in his heart that once burned with family fueld gold old fasioned vegeance.

items.name: Trinoceros
descriptions: When you're flashing this much ivory, it's not a bad idea to hire a lookout.

items.name: Spectacular Tufts
descriptions: Little known fact, duckshark meat is rich in vitamins and oils that are great for your hair.  Leaving you with a rich, full, luster and tufts not unlike the duckshark.

items.name: Pierre
descriptions: Won the award for Best Actor. Thanked no one.

items.name: Drive-thru
descriptions: A french fry man stranded in a popcorn world. Luckily for him, the stench of fried potatoes will never leave him.

items.name: Gems
descriptions: Gems are collected throughout BattleBlock Theater.  They are the primary currency for freeing new Prisoners when in the game, but of course can be traded for anything.

items.name: Centipete
descriptions: Puking on your food before eating it is clearly superior to all of the hard work that goes into chewing. Try it on date night: they'll appreciate the way you work smarter, not harder.

items.name: Cornelius Smallbladder
descriptions: Discovered the &quot;Wimplification Theorem&quot;, resulting in new products like the Suds Tuff line of soft-sponge dumb bells.

items.name: Rice Pilaf
descriptions: During a molecular gastronomy experiement, this side dish dollop found his way into a rice ball case and blammo! Rice pilaf ball!  A gastronomical sensation amongst peers.

items.name: Leo
descriptions: Shouting about where you are will never get you where you want to go.

items.name: Timber Jim
descriptions: Won a free cruise after donating the most at his neighborhood, &quot;Homes for Squirrels&quot; lumber fund drive.

items.name: Baby Clown Hair
descriptions: Like baby teeth, baby clown hair is eventually replaced by adult onset clown hair.

items.name: Wax On
descriptions: This whole mess would have been solved by a montage weeks ago, but he lost his cassette player in the shipwreck.

items.name: Gems
descriptions: Gems are collected throughout BattleBlock Theater.  They are the primary currency for freeing new Prisoners when in the game, but of course can be traded for anything.

items.name: Dragonhead
descriptions: He may not have wings or fire breath, but at least his face looks like a hideous reptile monster.

items.name: mogu
descriptions: Sociopathic megalomaniac. It all started with a cracker, and now he wants more...

items.name: Eleanor Gogglenobs
descriptions: Eleanor had the misfortune of losing an engine, ejecting, and parachuting onto the S.S. Friendship.  Lost at sea or on an island prison, she replays that day in her head over and over asking herself, &quot;Why was I doing barrel rolls in my prop plane?&quot;
